chunks: And when it is read out to them, say: 'We believe in it. It is the truth from our Lord. We had committed ourselves before it came.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the believers' response when the Quran is recited to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Fitrah* (innate disposition), suggesting that true belief is not merely a new acquisition but a return to the primordial submission already inherent in the believer's soul. It underscores the continuity between the message of the Quran and the monotheistic essence of the Prophets, reinforcing the Shia view of the unity of divine revelation across time.
